about.en: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. (InnoLight) is a Chinese manufacturer of high-speed optical transceiver modules used in data-center and AI computing networks and telecommunications. 3308 represents its H shares listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, which derivative markets quote under the ZHONGJI ticker, and is distinct from its A shares listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange ChiNext board as 300308.
